buildRecipe.Download pinned CUDA 13.4.1 build compon:
shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $env:CUDA_ROOT | Out-Null
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $env:NVIDIA_DOWNLOAD_CACHE | Out-Null

          function Add-CudaArchive([string]$name, [string]$relativePath, [string]$sha256) {
              $zip = Join-Path $env:NVIDIA_DOWNLOAD_CACHE "$name.zip"
              $extract = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "$name-extract"
              $url = "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/redist/$relativePath"
              if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $zip -PathType Leaf)) {
                  Write-Host "Downloading $url"
                  & curl.exe --fail --location --retry 3 --output $zip $url
                  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "curl failed for $name" }
              }
              else {
                  Write-Host "Using cached $name archive"
              }

              $actual = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $zip).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
              if ($actual -ne $sha256) {
                  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                  throw "$name SHA-256 mismatch: $actual"
              }

              Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $extract -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $extract
              $root = Get-ChildItem -Path $extract -Directory | Select-Object -First 1
              if (-not $root) { throw "$name archive did not contain a root directory" }
              Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $root.FullName '*') -Destination $env:CUDA_ROOT -Recurse -Force
          }

          Add-CudaArchive 'cuda_nvcc' `
            'cuda_nvcc/windows-x86_64/cuda_nvcc-windows-x86_64-13.4.59-archive.zip' `
            '06a4fe6ec543030c5e5a7b85493cda90612015d9fff2a54ed0227162c937ea46'
          Add-CudaArchive 'cuda_crt' `
            'cuda_crt/windows-x86_64/cuda_crt-windows-x86_64-13.4.59-archive.zip' `
            'f969a0e3b086a48f940563cd1b965cb5197fd9540c79cc952b1abfa479f9ede7'
          Add-CudaArchive 'libnvvm' `
            'libnvvm/windows-x86_64/libnvvm-windows-x86_64-13.4.59-archive.zip' `
            'a7a07bcc21cc05bce83eedebcbcd9b9f5418c58316b0fa28a57cb2c548b29841'
          Add-CudaArchive 'cuda_cudart' `
            'cuda_cudart/windows-x86_64/cuda_cudart-windows-x86_64-13.4.49-archive.zip' `
            'e6663f3d3e8949eedc2d5ab92c7c5b9fa3f2a222086d91c42bfc5a38bf2b0225'
          Add-CudaArchive 'cuda_cccl' `
            'cccl/windows-x86_64/cccl-windows-x86_64-13.3.4.2.1-archive.zip' `
            'ea3ebdd98d4d98819cc26b66bc5a0931004ed35ff18eea8b93e0bd2c8bfa5d7c'

          $nvcc = Join-Path $env:CUDA_ROOT 'bin\nvcc.exe'
          if (-not (Test-Path $nvcc)) { throw "nvcc not found at $nvcc" }
          & $nvcc --version
          "CUDAToolkit_ROOT=$env:CUDA_ROOT" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
          "$env:CUDA_ROOT\bin" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
buildRecipe.Configure and build runtime:
shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $vs = $env:VS_INSTALL
          Import-Module (Join-Path $vs 'Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll')
          Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vs -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64'

          cmake -S tools/RifeTensorRTRuntime -B $env:BUILD_DIR -G Ninja `
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release `
            "-DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER=$env:CUDA_ROOT\bin\nvcc.exe" `
            "-DCUDAToolkit_ROOT=$env:CUDA_ROOT" `
            "-DTENSORRT_ROOT=$env:TENSORRT_ROOT"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'CMake configure failed' }

          cmake --build $env:BUILD_DIR --parallel
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'RIFE runtime build failed' }

buildRecipe.Download and verify pinned RIFE sources:
shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p _rife-model/output/LICENSES

          curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
            --output _rife-model/rife_v8.7z \
            https://github.com/AmusementClub/vs-mlrt/releases/download/model-20220923/rife_v8.7z
          echo "$RIFE_LEGACY_SOURCE_SHA256  _rife-model/rife_v8.7z" | sha256sum --check --strict
          test "$(stat -c%s _rife-model/rife_v8.7z)" = "$RIFE_LEGACY_SOURCE_BYTES"

          curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
            --output _rife-model/rife_v4.15_lite.7z \
            https://github.com/AmusementClub/vs-mlrt/releases/download/external-models/rife_v4.15_lite.7z
          echo "$RIFE_415_LITE_SOURCE_SHA256  _rife-model/rife_v4.15_lite.7z" | sha256sum --check --strict
          test "$(stat -c%s _rife-model/rife_v4.15_lite.7z)" = "$RIFE_415_LITE_SOURCE_BYTES"

          curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
            --output _rife-model/rife_v4.25.7z \
            https://github.com/AmusementClub/vs-mlrt/releases/download/external-models/rife_v4.25.7z
          echo "$RIFE_425_SOURCE_SHA256  _rife-model/rife_v4.25.7z" | sha256sum --check --strict
          test "$(stat -c%s _rife-model/rife_v4.25.7z)" = "$RIFE_425_SOURCE_BYTES"

          curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
            --output _rife-model/rife_v4.25_lite.7z \
            https://github.com/AmusementClub/vs-mlrt/releases/download/external-models/rife_v4.25_lite.7z
          echo "$RIFE_425_LITE_SOURCE_SHA256  _rife-model/rife_v4.25_lite.7z" | sha256sum --check --strict
          test "$(stat -c%s _rife-model/rife_v4.25_lite.7z)" = "$RIFE_425_LITE_SOURCE_BYTES"

          curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
            --output _rife-model/output/LICENSES/RIFE-model-license.txt \
            "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hzwer/Practical-RIFE/$RIFE_LICENSE_COMMIT/LICENSE"
          echo "$RIFE_LICENSE_SHA256  _rife-model/output/LICENSES/RIFE-model-license.txt" | sha256sum --check --strict
buildRecipe.Convert RIFE variants to mixed FP16:
shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python tools/RifeTensorRTRuntime/prepare_model.py \
            --model 4.4 _rife-model/rife_v8.7z _rife-model/output/rife_v4.4.onnx
          python tools/RifeTensorRTRuntime/prepare_model.py \
            --model 4.6 _rife-model/rife_v8.7z _rife-model/output/rife_v4.6.onnx
          python tools/RifeTensorRTRuntime/prepare_model.py \
            --model 4.15-lite _rife-model/rife_v4.15_lite.7z _rife-model/output/rife_v4.15_lite.onnx
          python tools/RifeTensorRTRuntime/prepare_model.py \
            --model 4.25 _rife-model/rife_v4.25.7z _rife-model/output/rife_v4.25.onnx
          python tools/RifeTensorRTRuntime/prepare_model.py \
            --model 4.25-lite _rife-model/rife_v4.25_lite.7z _rife-model/output/rife_v4.25_lite.onnx
          python tools/RifeTensorRTRuntime/prepare_model.py \
            --write-manifest _rife-model/output \
            --source-archive 4.4=_rife-model/rife_v8.7z \
            --source-archive 4.6=_rife-model/rife_v8.7z \
            --source-archive 4.15-lite=_rife-model/rife_v4.15_lite.7z \
            --source-archive 4.25=_rife-model/rife_v4.25.7z \
            --source-archive 4.25-lite=_rife-model/rife_v4.25_lite.7z
buildRecipe.Prepare and verify reusable encoder stag:
